subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are writing to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on July 15th, 2023. Your flight is scheduled to depart at 9:00 AM from JFK Airport. Please arrive at least two hours prior to the departure time for check-in. If you have any questions or need to make changes to your booking, feel free to contact us. Thank you for choosing our airline. Safe travels! Regards, The Booking Team
